title: On Transferring the goods to the north store
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：transfer　|　正文 358 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 transfer 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the operator ① transferred the goods to the north store on the same day, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② transfers the goods to the north store before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ transfer the goods to the north store at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ transferred the goods to the north store before — a line in the log for June 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Transferring the goods to the north store on the same day, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ transfer to the office in town before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Transfer to the office in town at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ transfers to the office in town on the same day every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ transferred the goods to the north store again when nobody else would.

⑩ To transfer the goods to the north store, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody transfers the goods to the north store before dawn again and somebody must transfer the goods to the north store on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 转移（一般过去式 transferred the goods to the north store：1965 年操作员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 转移（一般现在 transfers the goods to the north store：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 转移（不定式 to transfer the goods to the north store：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 转移（过去完成时 had transferred the goods to the north store：1959 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 转移（动名词 transferring the goods to the north store 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 调动（transfer to the office in town：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去调动调到城里那间事务所）
G. v. 调动（transfer to the office in town：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 转移（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 transfers to the office in town，而母亲又一次 transferred the goods to the north store）

transfer 意为“转移”，自那以后操作员天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 transfers。
transfer 意为“转移”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯转移把货转到北边那间库房”，此处为不定式 to transfer the goods to the north store。
transfer 意为“转移”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人转移过，故用过去完成时 had transferred。

transfer 意为“调动”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去调动调到城里那间事务所”，should ever 之后用原形 transfer to the office in town。
transfer 意为“调动”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻调动调到城里那间事务所（transfer to the office in town at once），以后再也不要提起。
transfer 意为“转移”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例调动调到城里那间事务所，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 transfers。

transfer 意为“转移”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要转移把货转到北边那间库房，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 transfer 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the operator transferred the goods to the north store on the same day, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator transfers the goods to the north store before dawn whenever the station asks.
Transferring the goods to the north store on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever transfer to the office in town before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station transfers to the office in town on the same day every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother transferred the goods to the north store again, and the station remembered that half.
